name: Potion of Healing
description:
A wax-sealed vial holds red liquid that brightens when stirred. Drinking it restores 2d4 + 2 hit points. Drinking or administering it takes one action under the 2014 rules. The native healing activity rolls the healing; apply it to the intended recipient through the system.

Sold as one sealed single-dose potion.

weight.notes: Adjusted carried weight for the complete stated sale unit, including its disposable wrapping or supplied vessel; reusable workshop apparatus is excluded unless named in the sale unit.

name: Potion of Climbing
description:
Bands of coloured liquid remain separate even when the vial is shaken. For one hour after drinking, climbing speed equals walking speed and Strength (Athletics) checks to climb have advantage. The GM applies and ends these benefits manually; the use action only records consumption.

Sold as one sealed single-dose potion.
